title: DataAcquisitionRequest
description: A governed request to PROMOTE a catalogued object (document, dataset, or collection) from a user/project/chat scope to platform scope. Not all catalogued objects may be promoted: promotion is authorized only by an approved DataAcquisitionRequest, whose approval is the MEET (logical AND) of two independent gates — a governance review and an IP/legal rights review. Either gate pending or denied ⇒ the request is NOT approved (fail-closed). Mirrors the estate's decision-envelope family (ImagePromotionGate, PublishDecision) and the Truth = Law × Evidence meet.

specVersion.description: Spec version of this document, e.g. "2.0.0".

subjectRef.description: URN of the CatalogEntry being promoted.

fromScope.description: The origin scope the object is being promoted FROM.

toScope.description: Promotion target. Only platform promotion is governed by a DAR; this is pinned.

ipLegalReview.description: The IP / legal rights review gate. Carries the same decision vocabulary as any review, plus a rightsBasis.

decision.description: Independent gate decision. Default posture is 'pending' — absence of a decision is not approval.

rightsBasis.description: The IP/legal rights basis relied on (licence id, ownership assertion, consent ref). Expected when the IP/legal decision is 'approved'.

state.description: Overall request state. INVARIANT: 'approved' iff BOTH reviews are 'approved' (the meet); enforced here by schema and recomputed by the validator.

mintedDoi.description: The DOI minted for the subject entry when this request was approved and the entry promoted to platform (WO-COMMONS-2). Only an approved DAR may mint a DOI (allOf below); it must equal the entry's promotion.doi (cross-checked by the validator).

allOf.$comment: Fail-closed meet, at the schema level: state=approved REQUIRES both reviews approved.
Only an approved request may have minted a DOI.

decision.description: Independent gate decision. Default posture is 'pending' — absence of a decision is not approval.
